label: Classroom 019, DTU (building 352)
note: lecture room 019 in building 352 (classroom_readme.md), the room of dtu_room_019 (released with it), whose Readme gives 6.266 x 9.357 x 2.977 m; measured August 2019, before dtu_room_019 (2021); RIRDB measures 0.56 s at 500 Hz-1 kHz and 0.73 s at 250 Hz here, against 0.50 and 0.49 s in dtu_room_019's IRs of the same room (2021, loudspeakers away from the corners); folding dtu_room_019's IRs into 1 s periods, as a 1 Hz spectrum does, leaves their T30 unchanged, so the longer decay is in this 2019 measurement (loudspeaker in a corner), not in the inverse FFT; readme T60 about 0.5 s, Schroeder frequency 240 Hz; wooden floor, absorbing ceiling, windows with radiators on one long side; loudspeaker (Dynaudio BM6) in a corner; 4,761 points on a 1.7 x 1.7 m aperture at z = 1866 mm; IRs computed by inverse FFT of the published 1 Hz frequency responses (1 s at 10 kHz, content to 5 kHz; bins below 20 Hz are not measured data), analysed over the first 0.8 s because the level rises again over the last 0.15 s of each 1 s period (the inverse FFT is periodic); the levels have no stated unit
